scientific_integrity: Proof derives connectedness and genera; the finite-field checker only certifies existence of the required nonempty generic open; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the general smooth complex tridegree-(2,2,2) branch divisor. Describes the normalized closure of smooth-fiber lines, not every special-fiber component. Historical priority and complete monodromy remain open.
title: Two connected genus-seventeen line covers in a general tridegree-\((2,2,2)\) Fano threefold
